description: This file implements the advanced operation functions of the Ansc Daemon Socket UDP Object, including functions to finish, open, close, and enable receive/send on the socket.

classes.name: PANSC_DAEMON_SOCKET_UDP_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to the UDP socket object managed by the daemon.

classes.name: PANSC_DAEMON_ENGINE_UDP_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to the daemon engine managing UDP socket objects.

classes.name: PANSC_DAEMON_SERVER_UDP_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to the server object managing UDP sockets.

classes.name: PANSC_DSUO_WORKER_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to the worker object for socket management.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDkuoFinish(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Closes the socket object if it is not already closed, invoking the engine to delete the socket.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDkuoOpen(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the socket object, resetting byte counts and timestamps, and marking it as not closed.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDkuoClose(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Unloads the socket object, removes it from the worker, and closes the underlying socket depending on mode.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDkuoEnableRecv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bEnable)
methods.description: Configures whether receiving is enabled on the socket.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDkuoEnableSend(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bEnable)
methods.description: Configures whether sending is enabled on the socket.
